items.title: BA Stock Clocks Worst Day In Nearly 1.5 Years As FAA Reportedly Puts Max 10 Certification On Hold
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is delaying certification of the 737 Max 10 variant because of a newly flagged software issue, just as Boeing appeared close to winning approval to start delivering the jet, Bloomberg reported.

items.summary: Boeing recently informed airlines of a new 737 Max software issue affecting navigation equipment during certain landings. BA stock slides.

items.title: Will a New 737 MAX Software Glitch Delay Boeing’s Turnaround?
items.summary: Boeing  stock dropped early Monday after a new 737 MAX software problem emerged.  The problem hit shares of the software supplier,  GE Aerospace  too.  The move came after a weekend report from The Wall Street Journal about a MAX software glitch that can affect landing after an initial missed approach.
